content: {"like": ["The father’s scenes and the drama between the father and his friend had some actual weight."],"dislike": ["The anime was dry and boring with a dire lack of action.","The hero was bland and useless in fights until the end.","The constant fawning by young girls with annoying voices.","The bad guy’s motivations were mundane and boring.","There were not many awesome fight scenes.","The inclusion of a fanservice girl’s outfit seemed out of place for the samurai era.","The overall feel was a rather meh anime, comparable to Tenchi Muyo but not better."]}
